text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: PROMETHEUS_SCRAPE_ERRORS_HIGH for metrics-pipeline-prod (severity: P2). Affected job: prometheus/scrape-proxy -> target: node-exporter clusters. link: https://pd.company/INC-4321 :rotating_light:

pagerbot: Automated escalation to eng-sre oncall (alex). PagerDuty incident: https://pd.company/incidents/INC-4321 :pager:

alex: acked. I'm on it. Initial glance at grafana: scrape error rate jumped ~ 15:42 UTC, 90% of scrape-proxy pods returning 504/timeout.

sam: saw similar earlier in other region for /metrics endpoint. Could be upstream exporter or scrape-proxy egress throttling. Any recent deploys?

jin: no deploys in last 6h to scrape-proxy. autoscaler bumped to 3 -> 1 hour ago due to normal load.

maria: copying a couple quick checks:
1) kafka consumer lag for metrics-ingest (kafka-metrics-consumers)
2) pod-level network errors on scrape-proxy
3) s3 throttling for logstore (in case logs are blocking downstream pipelines)

alex: running commands now:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/scrape-proxy --since=5m --tail=200
```

alex: logs show repeated upstream timeouts and `dial tcp x.x.x.x:9100: i/o timeout` from node-exporter endpoints. Also a bunch of 502/504 from our internal proxy: `upstream connect error or disconnect`

sam: checking k8s node network: `ssh node-12` -> `dmesg` shows no obvious NIC errors. Network team pinged and they see packet loss ~0.5% to that AZ.

maria: running a health check against a few targets from within cluster:
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring run --rm -i --tty curltest --image=curlimages/curl -- curl -sS -D - http://10.2.14.7:9100/metrics | head -n 5
```
response: connection resets from a subset of nodes.

incidentbot: PagerDuty note added: "Investigating network errors causing prometheus scrape timeouts. Oncall performing mitigation: scale scrape-proxy and failover to alternate region."

jin: immediate mitigation plan:
- scale scrape-proxy deployment to 6 replicas
- temporarily route scrape traffic to backup scrape-proxy cluster (region fallback) via routing rule: prometheus -> scrape-proxy-backup
- increase scrape timeout for critical jobs from 10s -> 20s (short term)

alex: executing scale now: `kubectl -n monitoring scale deploy/scrape-proxy --replicas=6`

alex: also updating prometheus scrape_config for node-exporter job timeout: will push quick patch to configmap and reload prometheus: 
```bash
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap prometheus-server --patch '{"data":{"prometheus.yml":"...scrape_timeout: 20s..."}}'
kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deploy/prometheus-server
```

sam: monitoring kafka lag: consumer group `metrics-ingest` lag stable, no big backlog -> likely not downstream.

maria: changed routing to add backup. Ran a dry-run and then applied route. Confirmed that ~30% of scrapes are now routed to backup cluster.

alex: after scaling and fallback, scrape error rate dropped from 92% -> 18% in ~4 minutes. Latency for scraped targets improved.

pagerbot: PagerDuty note: oncall updated incident status: mitigated (partial). Please continue monitoring for 30m.

oncall-shadow: customer-impact check: looking at dashboards, ingested metrics for customer-facing dashboards (billing, alerts) delayed for ~4m window, some customers saw missing metrics for ~2m. Impact: low->medium. Ops-runbook suggests customer communication only if >10m.

sam: creating temporary alert suppression for downstream paging while we stabilize to avoid noise: silenced alert rule prometheus_scrape_errors_high for 20m in alertmanager.

alex: adding notes to incident: cause suspected intermittent network packet loss in AZ-us-east-2 affecting scrape-proxy -> node-exporter paths. Mitigation: increased replicas, routed to backup region, increased scrape timeout. Next steps: network team to run deeper investigation on fabric, follow-up RCA, and check BGP flaps.

maria: opened task NET-2217 and assigned to networking oncall (cc @networking) with logs and pcap request.

incidentbot: Incident acknowledged: INC-4321 assigned to alex. Severity P2. Estimated next update in 15m.

alex: leaving thread for now. Will monitor graphs and check again in 10m. If error rate spikes again I'll escalate to P1. Ping me if you see reoccurrence. :thumbsup:

jin: noted. Thanks team. I'll follow up with post-incident checklist and schedule a blameless postmortem if networking confirms root cause.

sam: +1. I'll prepare the alert tweak PR and link to postmortem draft.

maria: adding customer-impact summary for postmortem: affected customers: internal dashboards and ~3 external customers that query metrics directly; duration window ~4m; action: monitoring retained, no user-facing email required per runbook.

pagerbot: Incident INC-4321 status updated: monitored -> resolved for paging (silenced). Please close after postmortem.

incidentbot: Incident auto-note: "Mitigation actions: scaled scrape-proxy, rerouted to backup region, increased scrape timeout. Follow-up: NET-2217 assigned."

alex: closing thread in 30m after final verification. Good catch everyone. :coffee:
